dct_description_sm: This GIS dataset depicts the surficial geology of the Dizzy Creek area (NTS 84N/SE) (point features). The data are created in geodatabase format and output for public distribution in shapefile format. These data comprise the point features of Alberta Geological Survey Map 540, Surficial Geology of the Dizzy Creek Area (NTS 84N/SE).
dct_title_s: Surficial Geology of the Dizzy Creek Area (NTS 84N/SE) (GIS data, point features)
